descriptionChirho: The proper name Yephunneh (יְפֻנֶּה), borne by two figures: primarily the father of Caleb the Kenizzite (Num 13:6, 14:6, 30, 26:65, 32:12; Deut 1:36; Josh 14:6, 13, 14, 15:13, 21:12; 1 Chr 4:15, 6:41) and also the father of an Asherite in 1 Chr 7:38. All three sense clusters are minor transliteration variants of the identical name: Jephunneh (S103066, 9x), Yephunneh (S103067, 4x), Yefunneh (S103068, 3x). Multilingual renderings confirm a single name: Spanish Jefone/Jefuné/Yefune, Arabic يَفُنَّةَ (Yafunna), Hindi यफुन्ने/यपुन्ने (Yaphunne), Korean 여분네 (Yeobunne), Swahili Yefune.
